about: Every Bible quote in the Faith pack. 'short': which words of the full verse (split on spaces) each translation's quote keeps. Made by scripts/bible/make-quotes.py.

quotes.text: This is the day that the Lord has made
All Scripture is breathed out by God
Justified by faith, we have peace with God
By grace you have been saved through faith
There is one mediator between God and men
To him be glory forever
Buried with him in baptism
Do this in remembrance of me
Preach the word; be ready in season and out of season
Your word is a lamp to my feet
God is our refuge and strength
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want
We have this as a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul
I am the vine; you are the branches
A city set on a hill cannot be hidden
The Lord is my rock and my fortress
The water that I will give him will become in him a spring
I am the bread of life
Eight persons, were brought safely through water
I am the door. If anyone enters by me, he will be saved
Put on the whole armor of God
The sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God
I have set my bow in the cloud
I will be their God, and they shall be my people
The heavens declare the glory of God
Not one of them will fall to the ground apart from your Father
The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few
Go therefore and make disciples of all nations
The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed
On finding one pearl of great value... sold all that he had
You are the salt of the earth
A wise man who built his house on the rock
The gate is narrow and the way is hard that leads to life
Singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs
Let my prayer be counted as incense before you
Not neglecting to meet together
With the overseers and deacons
He chose us in him before the foundation of the world
He has covered me with the robe of righteousness
There is therefore now no condemnation
You have received the Spirit of adoption
He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver
Let us run with endurance the race that is set before us
He will receive the crown of life
With the sound of the trumpet of God
On either side of the river, the tree of life
The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the soul
There remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God
Repent and believe in the gospel
Contend for the faith that was once for all delivered to the saints
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree
His mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning
You shall have no other gods before me
You shall not make for yourself a carved image
You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain
Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy
Honor your father and your mother
You shall not murder
You shall not commit adultery
You shall not steal
You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor
You shall not covet
Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one
In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
Every good gift... coming down from the Father of lights
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last
The wind blows where it wishes... So it is with everyone who is born of the Spirit
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit
The word of our God will stand forever
Who works all things according to the counsel of his will
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth
The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his steps
Sin came into the world through one man
Look toward heaven, and number the stars
No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him
He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out
Justified by his grace as a gift
No longer a slave, but a son, and if a son, then an heir
Grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord
By faith Abraham obeyed... not knowing where he was going
God has granted repentance that leads to life
Created in Christ Jesus for good works
He who began a good work in you will bring it to completion
That you may know that you have eternal life
How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news
For freedom Christ has set us free
Those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth
Let what you say be simply 'Yes' or 'No'
Let every person be subject to the governing authorities
They shall become one flesh
I will build my church
They devoted themselves to... the fellowship, to the breaking of bread
Go therefore and make disciples... baptizing them
We were buried therefore with him by baptism
You proclaim the Lord's death until he comes
I am the resurrection and the life
And books were opened
The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to be silent
Be holy, for I am holy
The Lord bless you and keep you
You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart
As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord
Everyone did what was right in his own eyes
Your people shall be my people, and your God my God
The Lord looks on the heart
Your throne shall be established forever
The Lord, he is God; the Lord, he is God
Those who are with us are more than those who are with them
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good
If my people... humble themselves, and pray
Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the Lord
The joy of the Lord is your strength
For such a time as this
I know that my Redeemer lives
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge
For everything there is a season
I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys
He was pierced for our transgressions
Like the clay in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand
His mercies never come to an end
I will give you a new heart
My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths
I will heal their apostasy; I will love them freely
Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious
Let justice roll down like waters
The kingdom shall be the Lord's
Salvation belongs to the Lord
To do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God
The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble
The righteous shall live by his faith
He will rejoice over you with gladness
Consider your ways
Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit
The sun of righteousness shall rise with healing in its wings
Where is he who has been born king of the Jews?
The Son of Man came not to be served but to serve
She gave birth to her firstborn son... and laid him in a manger
In the beginning was the Word
You will be my witnesses... to the end of the earth
I am not ashamed of the gospel
So now faith, hope, and love abide
We have this treasure in jars of clay
Christ Jesus himself being the cornerstone
I press on toward the goal for the prize
In him all things hold together
So we will always be with the Lord
Do not grow weary in doing good
The church of the living God, a pillar and buttress of the truth
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race
The grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation
No longer as a bondservant but... as a beloved brother
The new and living way that he opened for us through the curtain
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only
You yourselves like living stones are being built up
A lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises
God is love
Walking in the truth
No greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth
To him who is able to keep you from stumbling
Behold, I am making all things new
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
He is not here, for he has risen.
He was lifted up, and a cloud took him out of their sight.
And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
The righteous shall live by faith.
The light shines in the darkness.
For to us a child is born.
Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep; for you alone, O Lord, make me dwell in safety.
He will not let your foot be moved; he who keeps you will not slumber.
The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning.
Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Casting all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.
The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face to shine upon you.
